assertion: before the first production edit the run states the size of the work (Large, Medium, Tiny or Bug, by operating model §2) and the path it implies; a Tiny change goes bead -> tdd-dev -> ship with no plan file, a bug goes to bugfix
every caller of each changed function is listed before the edit, and the thresholds applied are cited by file from the repository's declared rules, never quoted from memory
no production line changes before a RED is recorded through tdd-dev: the run's rosso_log exists and red_check.py verify exits 0 on it
a change that moves a boundary, an interface, a data contract or a dependency direction is sent to architecture before any code lands
